title: packet-5co-legacy.c: General improvements
description:
1a. Break out the "script generated register code" into a format that is more agreeable with Wireshark code analysis tools for catching potential bugs.
1b. Adjust hf_ "field types" so less custom functions are needed and better filtering can be done on existing fields.

commits_data.message:
packet-5co-legacy.c: General improvements

1a. Break out the "script generated register code" into a format that is more agreeable with Wireshark code analysis tools for catching potential bugs.
1b. Adjust hf_ "field types" so less custom functions are needed and better filtering can be done on existing fields.
2. Properly set TCP/UDP ports used with preferences since the ports used are not IANA registered
3. Use IP checksum function since it's the same for 5co-legacy
4. Add more filterable fields instead of them just being appending text to parent.
